svg.title: Retry decision for one failed request
svg.desc: A decision flow. Question one: is the answer 429 or one of the three service protection codes? If yes, the request is throttled: the server did not process it, so wait exactly Retry-After and repeat it, whatever the method. If no, question two: is it 408, 502, 503, 504 or a lost connection? If yes, it is transient and the outcome is unknown, so ask whether the request is idempotent, that is GET, DELETE, PATCH with If-Match or a repeatable action. Idempotent: wait with exponential backoff and jitter, 1, 2, 4, 8 seconds up to a cap, and repeat. Not idempotent, such as a POST that creates a row: do not repeat; report an unknown outcome and check before sending again. If no, question three: is it 412? Then it is a conflict: read the row again and decide again. Otherwise it is permanent, for example 400 from a plug-in, 401, 403 or 404: report and never repeat. Every repeat first passes a gate: attempts left, at most six, and waiting budget left, at most 600 seconds. If not, give up: raise an error that carries the kind and the last Retry-After, and exit with code 3.
svg.text: One failed request: classify first, then decide
THROTTLED: the server did not process it
Wait exactly Retry-After, then send the same request again. Any method, POST included.
TRANSIENT: it may or may not have been processed
Idempotent (GET, DELETE, PATCH with If-Match, repeatable action):
back off 1, 2, 4, 8 … s (cap 60 s) with jitter, then repeat.
Not idempotent (a POST that creates): do NOT repeat. Report "outcome unknown".
Not a retry. Read again, decide again, a bounded number of times (lesson 78).
The same request gets the same answer. Report it to a person. Never repeat.
Gate before every repeat: attempts left (max 6)? waiting budget left (max 600 s)?
If not: give up, raise an error that carries the kind and the last Retry-After, exit with code 3. An idempotent job can simply run again later.
